messages:
deploy-bot: Kicking off staged canary for release v3.19. Change window 2026-04-18 13:00-14:00 UTC. Targets: canary-eu & canary-us, staged groups=3 then 3. Release notes: https://internal.redwood.dev/releases/v3.19
olivia: Can we get the backout/runbook link and a 1-line rollback owner? Also, if we need to pin, prefer dual-cluster pin command so stable doesn't get noisy.
matt: Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.dev/display/OPS/Backout-v3.19. I'll own rollback for canaries. Dual-pin sample: `rdeploy pin --clusters canary-eu,canary-us --image redwood:v3.18 --duration 30m --note "dual-cluster temp pin"`
devops-bot: Auto-guard rules set: p95 >195ms for 3m OR 5xx >0.5% -> auto-pause and notify thread. Also DB-migration flag `ff/db/allow_ordered_mig` is OFF on canaries.
qa-bot: Adding quick checklist for channel visibility: 1) `rdeploy rollback --to-tag redwood:v3.18 --clusters canary-eu,canary-us` 2) `kubectl rollout restart deployment/edge-proxy -n redwood --selector region in (eu,us)` 3) flush caches: `redis-cli -h cache.canary-eu FLUSHDB && redis-cli -h cache.canary-us FLUSHDB` 4) check migrator logs: `kubectl logs -n redwood -l app=db-migrator | grep -i error` 5) notify product & update release notes.
oncall-bot: Rollback owner assigned: matt. Pager: +1-555-0444. Escalation path: oncall -> eng-sre -> eng-platform.
deploy-bot: Canary progress: eu 1/3 OK, us 1/3 OK, eu 2/3 degraded (p95=210ms) -> auto-pause triggered for eu by p95>195ms. Holding further rollouts.
olivia: Noted. Matt, do dual-pin or full rollback? If degradation only in eu, prefer pin eu only to limit blast radius.
matt: Looking at metrics: eu p95=210ms, us p95=98ms, 5xx eu=0.15%. No DB errors yet. I'll do an eu-only hotpin first: `rdeploy hotpin --cluster canary-eu --image redwood:v3.19 --duration 20m --threshold p95=200ms`. If issues persist, execute full rollback to v3.18 across both canaries.
deploy-bot: Hotpin executed by matt at 2026-04-18T13:07:30Z.
qa-bot: Post-hotpin metrics: eu p95 back to 110ms, 5xx steady. Recommend 10m watch before resuming.
olivia: Good call. Product looped for release-note edits if we end up rolling back.
product-bot: Product notified. Will draft a short blurb if rollback becomes necessary.
matt: Monitoring. If eu re-degrades or DB errors surface, I'll run the rollback checklist across both clusters.
olivia: Thanks all — please add a short postmortem note to the release ticket if we escalate. Closing this thread after watch window.
